_source: tools/routes_full.py (PhaseInfo.bxm, pXXX_sub.bxm, ChapterData.cha, QuestChapterData.qch, pXXX_hap.z, quest_rewards.json, NieRAutomata.exe)
_notes: Order of steps = order of SubPhase entries in pXXX_sub.bxm (A/B: p100 then p200; C/D: p300 sorted by chapter label then file order, since A2/9S chapters interleave in the file).
Route membership = route token of the sub-phase name: A route = A+AB, B route = B+AB, C/D = CD/C/D.
chapter = Chapter Select entry (ChapterData.cha) that starts at this sub-phase, else the previous entry (same character when the name ends in _2B/_9S/_A2) : 'chapter_assignment' says which.
area: Japanese location keyword of the sub-phase comment, else the English token of the name, else the majority area of the room (g* rooms are sub-maps; r001 = open world). Unofficial translation.
start_pos = PlayerPos of the sub-phase (x y z [rot_y]); null when 0 0 0 (cutscene / shmup / menu).

side_quests_available = quests present in QuestChapterData.qch for the chapter entry and allowed for the playable character (1=2B, 2=9S, 3=A2, 4=any). These are Chapter Select windows, not prerequisites.
Hap group tokens (code 0xF3B97443) are crc32(sub-phase name): used for 'from_subphases' of transitions.
